toast.alarm1: ALARM 1 - DRONES ARE COMING TO LOOK
hint.start: Walking is quiet. Hold Shift to sprint - it is loud. C or Ctrl to crouch behind cover. Double tap a direction to dash.
hint.camera: A camera. Its red eye shows where it looks; hold Tab to see its view. Crouch behind the blocks and move when it looks away.
hint.sensor: Hold Tab for network vision: it shows the sensor zones. Walk or crouch through - never sprint, dash or jump.
hint.niche: Server blocks hide you while you crouch behind them. Stand up and your head shows.
hint.terminal: A terminal. E to hack it - you stand still while you work, and the security keeps moving.
hint.sound: A sound camera listens around it (Tab shows how far). Walk or crouch - do not sprint, jump or fight.
hint.redWall: A red wall. Find the terminal that controls it - or bring the whole alarm down on you.
hint.warden: A warden. It sees where its visor looks and turns slowly - stay out of its view, or walk up behind its back.
